summary: `GeminiBoundedClient` implements the bounded Gemini API transport, but `configure_backfill_runtime` binds a single client factory across all stages even though `GeminiBoundedClient` rejects the non-`gemini-api/*` models required for consolidation and quality. The consolidation preflight test masks this by passing `client_factory=factory`, which bypasses the `--client gemini-api` default factory selection and `GeminiBoundedClient` model validation entirely. All runtime behavior and test/check results remain unverified because `evidence.txt` contains only a self-reported `[WORKER_DONE]` summary block (which also lists two `docs/generated/release-truth.*` files absent from `diff.patch`) rather than actual command or test output.

findings.point: When `--client gemini-api` is selected without an injected `client_factory`, `configure_backfill_runtime` sets `factory = GeminiBoundedClient` for all stages, including consolidation and quality. However, `GeminiBoundedClient.__init__` (`memorymaster/dreaming/providers.py:608-610`) raises `ProviderConfigError(..., reason='invalid_model')` for any model not prefixed with `gemini-api/`, while consolidation/quality retain `anthropic/claude-sonnet-*` and Haiku requirements (`evidence.txt:4`), making non-extract stages fail preflight in unverified runtime execution.
findings.evidence: diff.patch:34-36 (`if provider != "gemini-api" ... raise ProviderConfigError("Gemini API requires a gemini-api-qualified model", reason="invalid_model")`), diff.patch:102-104 (`if getattr(args, "client", "opencode") == "gemini-api": factory = client_factory or GeminiBoundedClient`), and evidence.txt:4 (`Real Gemini supports extraction; consolidation/quality retain Sonnet/Haiku requirements`).
findings.suggestion: Either route only the extractor (or `gemini-api/*`-prefixed models) through `GeminiBoundedClient` when `client_factory is None`, or explicitly reject `--client gemini-api` for non-`extract` stages with a clear preflight `ValueError` if non-Gemini consolidator/quality models cannot be dispatched.

findings.point: `test_gemini_api_cli_preflight_binds_extractor_and_consolidator_with_fake_factory` passes `client_factory=factory` directly to `configure_backfill_runtime`, which short-circuits `factory = client_factory or GeminiBoundedClient` (`memorymaster/surfaces/backfill_cli.py:54`). Because `client_factory` is truthy, this test never exercises the `--client gemini-api` branch (it would behave identically with `--client opencode`) and hides that `--consolidator-model anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6` is rejected by `GeminiBoundedClient`.
findings.evidence: diff.patch:102-104 (`factory = client_factory or OpenCodeClient; if getattr(args, "client", "opencode") == "gemini-api": factory = client_factory or GeminiBoundedClient`) and diff.patch:145-157 (`"--client", "gemini-api", ... "--consolidator-model", "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6" ... configure_backfill_runtime(args, runner, client_factory=factory)`).
findings.suggestion: Test `configure_backfill_runtime(args, runner)` without passing `client_factory` (e.g., via `monkeypatch.setattr` as in `test_gemini_api_cli_preflight_binds_extractor_with_fake_factory` at lines 445-462, or by injecting a fake transport into `GeminiBoundedClient`) so the `--client gemini-api` dispatch path and model validation are actually exercised.
